Topics · Prayer and closeness to God

Can I speak to God directly?

People asked about God and He answered Himself. Your call is direct prayer; others' prayers stay a gift.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:186

Translation

Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

Original · Hebrew

קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃

the Psalms · 145:18

World English Bible

Why would anyone feel they cannot pray to God directly? Usually for one of four reasons: the one asked is far, or unaware, or unwilling, or unable. Remove the four and that feeling loses its ground. This verse answers the first in one word: near. Then the rest: I answer whoever calls Me. Notice who speaks. The Prophet is not told "say to them"; the answer comes straight, in the voice of "I". The sentence itself is spoken directly to the one who asks.

A question for you

If you ever felt you needed someone to carry your words to God, which of the four is nearest that feeling?

If you sayThat He is far
ThenThen you have another question close by: how near is God?
If you sayThat He will not listen to someone like me
ThenThat is what hurts people most. It has an answer in a question of its own, and a merciful one.
If you sayI do not feel this
ThenThen you are near what the verse says. What would you say to Him today?

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.

Quran · Ghafir 40:60

Translation

‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

Original · Hebrew

קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וְאֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ וְאַגִּ֧ידָה לְּךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּבְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃

Jeremiah · 33:3

World English Bible

﴿أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَـٰهٌ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth?[1084] Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.

Translator's notes

[1084] Generation after generation.

Quran · An-Naml 27:62

Translation

For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,

Original · Hebrew

כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

the Psalms · 18:31

World English Bible

The call here is a command, not just a permission: call on Me, and I will answer you. The relationship begins from God. The second verse asks who answers the desperate when they call, a question people can answer in their worst hours. Neither verse sets a condition of language, place or rank. The first mentions those too proud to do it, so the obstacle named is not distance or sin but pride. Pride can keep even a child from calling their mother.

A question for you

What sentence would you begin with, if you began?

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِى قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [there is a share for] those who come after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."

Quran · Al-Hashr 59:10

Translation

My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake. Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

Original · Hebrew

הַטֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהַ֥י ׀ אָזְנְךָ֮ וּֽשֲׁמָע֒ פְּקַ֣ח עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּרְאֵה֙ שֹֽׁמְמֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְהָעִ֕יר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְךָ֖ עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֣י ׀ לֹ֣א עַל־צִדְקֹתֵ֗ינוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ מַפִּילִ֤ים תַּחֲנוּנֵ֨ינוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֖י עַל־רַחֲמֶ֥יךָ הָרַבִּֽים׃ אֲדֹנָ֤י ׀ שְׁמָ֨עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י ׀ סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַֽקֲשִׁ֥יבָה וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעֲנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ׃

Daniel · 9:18-19

World English Bible

Does this mean no one should pray for anyone? No. This verse shows believers praying for those who came before them, and the Quran praises it. The distinction is clear. That your call reaches God needs no one. That someone who loves you prays for you is a gift. Direct prayer does not mean living alone. It means the door is not shut on you when you are alone. Love keeps its place, and trust keeps its place.

A question for you

To you, what separates someone praying for you from needing them for your words to arrive?

If you sayOne is love, the other a worry
ThenA lovely way to see it. You may still ask why people feel that worry at all.
If you sayI see little difference
ThenThis is a long conversation among people of faith, and the definition here keeps that line with care. You can return to it.
